A three-point shot; a basket made from beyond the three-point line.

examples:
October 1930, Paul Paddock, "I Solo in Seven Hours", Popular Mechanics
Away I roared once more, resolved to score a three-pointer. I glided down to a good start but estimated my altitude wrongly.
wiktionary.gloss: A three-point landing; an airplane landing in which all three wheels touch the ground simultaneously.
A deer or other animal whose antlers feature three points or tines.

blocks.etymology: Latin -āriusnom. From trend + setter.
vi_block: Người lăng xê mốt (người đi đầu về thời trang).

examples: Near-synonyms: influencer, thought leader
wiktionary.gloss: Someone who starts a trend, or makes something more popular.

blocks.etymology: From Middle French tulipe, from earlier tulipan, from Ottoman Turkish دلبند (tülbent, dülbent, “cheesecloth”), from Classical Persian دلبند (dulband, “turban”). Doublet of turban.

senses.definition: a cup-shaped spring flower grown from a bulb, or the plant that produces it

examples.en: She planted red tulip bulbs in her front yard.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã trồng những củ hoa tuy-líp đỏ ở sân trước.

senses.vi: hoa uất kim hương; hoa tuy-líp

thesaurus.definition: any of numerous perennial bulbous herbs having linear or broadly lanceolate leaves and usually a single showy flower

wiktionary.gloss: A type of flowering plant, genus Tulipa.
The flower of this plant.
wiktionary.vi: uất kim hương; uất kim cương; tulip; tu-líp

tatoeba.en: She grows flowers such as tulips, pansies and daisies.
tatoeba.vi: Cô ấy đang trồng nhiều loại hoa như là hoa tulip, hoa păng xê và hoa cúc anh.

blocks.etymology: Latin tumultuārius: compare French tumultuaire.

examples:

a tumultuary conflict
wiktionary.gloss: Attended by, or producing, a tumult; disorderly; confused; tumultuous.
restless; agitated; unquiet

examples: Scheme is a typed language.

Không bị cản trở, không bị cãi lại, không bị làm trái ý.
